verdict.rationale: Shortcut's marketing says users can map projects across teams, track work in one place with health status and target dates, and visualize Epics on a Roadmap. These amount to a cross-project view, but the evidence never shows progress actually rolling up into a single portfolio view. missing for 10: explicit documentation of aggregated progress roll-up across multiple projects, details of a dedicated portfolio view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view

citations.quote: Map out projects across teams, track work from people and agents in one place, communicate health status, and share target dates.
Create goals, align teams, and connect individual projects to company objectives.
